title: CAN Unpack
text: Unpack individual signals from CAN messages, 1 input, 1 output, {Data to output as} sets Select your; {Database file} sets the aRXML or CAN database file character, {Message list} sets the cAN message list array of character, {Name} sets the cAN message name, {Identifier type} sets the cAN identifier type Standard, {CAN Identifier} sets the cAN message identifier, {Length (bytes)} sets the cAN message length, {Add signal} adds CAN signal, {Delete signal} sets the remove CAN signal, {Signals}, {Output identifier} adds CAN ID output port, {Output timestamp} adds Timestamp output port, {Output error} adds Error output port, {Output remote} adds Remote output port, {Output length} adds Length output port and {Output status} adds Status output port. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Data
ports.summary: CAN signal output single | double | int8 | int16 | int32 | int64 | uint8 | uint16 | uint32 | uint64 | boolean

params.name: Data to output as
params.values: Select your data signal raw data (default) | manually specify signals | CANdb specified signals | ARXML specified signals

params.name: Database file
params.values: ARXML or CAN database file character vector

params.name: Message list
params.values: CAN message list array of character vectors

params.name: Name
params.values: CAN message name CAN Msg (default) | character vector

params.name: Identifier type
params.values: CAN identifier type Standard (11-bit identifier) (default) | Extended (29-bit identifier)

params.name: Output identifier
params.values: Add CAN ID output port off (default)

params.name: Output timestamp
params.values: Add Timestamp output port off (default) | on

params.name: Output error
params.values: Add Error output port off (default) | on

params.name: Output remote
params.values: Add Remote output port off (default) | on

params.name: Output length
params.values: Add Length output port off (default) | on

params.name: Output status
params.values: Add Status output port off (default) | on
